purpose: Finite operating-point selection after preserved SQLite busy and generator-saturation observations; not a maximum-capacity estimate or a repair of original adverse rows.
selection_rule: Run both declared candidates once as two fresh processes per supported route/case, using the repaired unchanged A21 validity and durable-oracle gates. Select the largest rate whose entire family search is complete and valid. Do not use observed latency or a favorable route to select a winner. If neither passes, retain the lower candidate as an explicitly unvalidated operating point; its full calibration remains required and cannot inherit a search pass.
unchanged: All three applications/native artifacts and original locks
Payloads, schema, authentication, protocol, maximum client concurrency and original warmups
Original A21 timing/generator-lag/timeout/in-flight bounds and statistical implementation
Cold create1@1/s,8MiB stream20@2/s,upload overload80@20/s and nine diagnostic profiles including2300-event exporter saturation
matrix_rule: Freeze the selected profile before final calibration. For every original full case run3 fresh calibration processes per supported route. Run3 separate confirmation processes only if that entire case calibration is complete and valid with matching input fingerprints and measured bands. Retain every invalid case and explicitly unexecuted confirmation; do not retry or tune after this finite search.
order: Seeded shuffle of search units; seeded shuffle of final case cohorts. Each original A21 controller separately shuffles route/process order; confirmation uses its independent seed offset.
comparison_scope: Each case is an independent immutable calibration/confirmation cohort. No mixed-fingerprint band reuse. Diagnostic and DI comparisons require complete independent confirmation cohorts and both frozen bands.
omissions: Windows and other platforms are outside this run;24h/72h omitted at user instruction in B22, not replaced by these finite performance cells.
